'''Kauf Ularno''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|General]] in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] and was the second-in-command to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]]. Although a rather unimaginative military mind, he was steadfastly [[New Order/Legends|loyal]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
